changes.before: The virus and the measures taken to protect public health are inducing sharp declines in economic activity and a surge in job losses.
changes.after: The virus and the measures taken to protect public health have induced sharp declines in economic activity and a surge in job losses.

changes.before: The disruptions to economic activity here and abroad have significantly affected financial conditions and have impaired the flow of credit to U.S. households and businesses.
changes.after: Financial conditions have improved, in part reflecting policy measures to support the economy and the flow of credit to U.S. households and businesses.

changes.before: the Federal Reserve will continue to purchase Treasury securities and agency residential and commercial mortgage-backed securities in the amounts needed to support smooth market functioning
changes.after: over coming months the Federal Reserve will increase its holdings of Treasury securities and agency residential and commercial mortgage-backed securities at least at the current pace to sustain smooth market functioning

changes.before: The Committee will closely monitor market conditions and is prepared to adjust its plans as appropriate.
changes.after: The Committee will closely monitor developments and is prepared to adjust its plans as appropriate.

parsed.rationale: The statement replaces open-ended, market-functioning-contingent purchases with an explicit commitment to increase holdings at least at the current pace over coming months, a dovish forward commitment on the balance sheet. This outweighs the modestly hawkish acknowledgment that financial conditions have improved.

spans.quote: The virus and the measures taken to protect public health are inducing sharp declines in economic activity and a surge in job losses.
The disruptions to economic activity here and abroad have significantly affected financial conditions and have impaired the flow of credit to U.S. households and businesses.
the Federal Reserve will continue to purchase Treasury securities and agency residential and commercial mortgage-backed securities in the amounts needed to support smooth market functioning
The Committee will closely monitor market conditions and is prepared to adjust its plans as appropriate.
The virus and the measures taken to protect public health have induced sharp declines in economic activity and a surge in job losses.
Financial conditions have improved, in part reflecting policy measures to support the economy and the flow of credit to U.S. households and businesses.

over coming months the Federal Reserve will increase its holdings of Treasury securities and agency residential and commercial mortgage-backed securities at least at the current pace to sustain smooth market functioning
The Committee will closely monitor developments and is prepared to adjust its plans as appropriate.
